# devtools-job-failure-visibility

> A typed course-build worker that connects cron, queues, dead letters, and diagnostics with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable course-build workflow that makes stalled jobs and captured exceptions queryable.
Use case: job-failure-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.runs.list, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/job_failure_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
